meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are pounds that covered facilities reported releasing, kept for research and market sizing. A release is not an exposure, a finding that anyone was harmed or a finding of fault, and the Toxics Release Inventory covers only listed chemicals and facilities above reporting thresholds. Questions about exposure or injury are for a licensed attorney or a health professional.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.title: Toxic chemical releases by county first published
changes.summary: On-site releases of toxic chemicals reported to EPA's Toxics Release Inventory for reporting year 2024 in every county with a reporting facility, every state and the US: 2,842,308,160 pounds from 21,482 facilities, with the 4 earlier years' totals.
